title: Preserve upstream proxy mode when selecting the HTTP layer
answers: Which HTTP mode should upstream proxy connections use?
How should NextLayer choose between upstream and regular HTTP mode?
Why is upstream proxy traffic being handled in regular HTTP mode?
body:
Invariant: The HTTP layer added in this stack-construction branch must use HTTPMode.upstream when context.layers[0] is a modes.HttpUpstreamProxy, and HTTPMode.regular otherwise.
Enforcement: mitmproxy/addons/next_layer.py:NextLayer checks the first context layer before constructing layers.HttpLayer.
Failure if skipped: Unconditionally selecting HTTPMode.regular assigns regular HTTP handling to an upstream proxy stack.
Constraints: This rule applies to the HTTP-layer construction branch shown here; it does not establish mode-selection rules for other branches.
applies: HTTP mode selection in the affected NextLayer stack-construction branch.
